descriptionMarkdown: My version of Luke Dupin's shattered planet ship the WhiteWidow SuperCheese. Luke's design primarily used base-level components, and by the time I was ready to build this ship I had a steady stream of iron, charcoal, and LDS shuffle products to make some legendary (or higher than base quality) components for this ship. Luke's video shows this is likely not necessary, though in some areas of the factory there are fewer beacon's than in his design, which will impact outputs. Extra space at the front of the ship is for building what I need while traveling to the shattered planet, and for storing promethium chunks. Luke's design used modified inserters that rotate 90 degrees. I am playing unmodded, so I modified the design for standard inserters, hence the180 in the name. Relevant research levels: explosives 16, railgun damage 8, railgun shooting speed 8, laser weapon damage 14, steel plate productivity 9, asteroid productivity 11 -- these are likely not the minimums, as I made it to the shattered planet without issue.
title: WhiteWidow SuperCheese-180
